notes.title: 0.11.2 - Smoother UI, Death Screen, Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Joystick improvements[/b]: Decrease Deadzone.
[*][b]Scoreboard[/b]: Improvements with loading, error messages
[*][b]Death Screeen[/b]: Redesign death screen.
[*][b]Level Preview[/b]: Improve animations.
[*][b]Level Complete[/b]: Solid background added.

notes.title: 0.11.0 - New levels, The Big QOL Update.
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelog for Version 0.11.0[/h1]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]New Levels[/b]: A new set of levels for Sector 1 and 2.
[*][b]UI Overhaul[/b]: Redesigned UI and HUD with centered, limited camera. 
[*][b]Electrical System 2.0[/b]: Added sockets to the electrical system.
[*][b]New Visuals[/b]: Added new fonts and an art pass.
[*][b]Overworld[/b]: New lighting and improved truck handling.
[*][b]Remastered Tracks[/b]: Updated audio tracks. 
[*][b]Feedback[/b]: Haptic feedback, play audio when UI is interacted with.
[*][b]Level Complete Screen[/b]: Shows both old and new report cards.  
[*][b]Settings[/b]: Improved settings menu, option to opt-out of high-score uploading.
[/list]

[h2]Improved[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Hold to Undo[/b]: Spamming keys no more.
[*][b]Play mode from Level Editor[/b]: Added a "Play" button, plus shortcuts to the Level Editor.
[/list]

Have fun!
